findings.text: follow-on: the two-arm suite delta runs only scripts/prototypes/read_route/check_legacy.py, which loads jets.py by path and never imports the new scripts/prototypes/fixed_points modules, so added_failure_count is 0 by construction and the delta cannot detect a regression in the changed fixed_points code.

follow-on: the diverted 10000-cell booking records a booked-moment relative difference of 0.7199 against 0.00032/0.00017 at the lower rungs with matrix source hashes unchanged, an unexplained anomaly the node correctly left to the upstream booking owner outside its scope.
